shared_elements: animals or creatures rendered in profile
multiple figures arranged across a single surface
justification: Both surfaces show schematic living figures spread across a rock face, and one could loosely liken the raised-arm posture of A's painted humans to the raised forelimb of B's carved quadrupeds, but this is a very generic correspondence. A depicts two frontal, stick-limbed human hunters brandishing a linear weapon in an open scene, while B depicts a register-organised composition of profile animals, a bird with a disc, a snake-like descending form and a row of repeated arm/hand motifs beneath a band of pattern; the subject matter, organisation into bands, and carving conventions are essentially unrelated.
